messages.subject: Problems with opening excel files
parts:
Hey everyone,

I am facing problems with opening tables from excel files. Very often
only some columns are loaded into
the data viewer and I really don't undestand why this keeps happening.
Tried to format the fields,
but this doesn't change anything. I use excel 2003. I don't know
whether there is difference in the newer versions of
excel.
Help would be very much appreciated.

Best,
Marlon.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Problems with opening excel files
parts:
Hi Marlon,

First the bad news,... JGR/Deducer does not provide a way to import
excel data files. you need to first save as a cvs, and then load them.

Next the good news,... This will change with the next release of JGR,
which will use the XLConnect package to bring in .xls and .xlsx files.
Those of you who know how to install the development version of JGR
can chack it out.


Ian
